name: Spitfire bearer imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, holding a squirming orange fire newt lizard in both claws like a water pistol, the lizard's mouth glowing

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, the orange fire newt held out in front in both claws
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: breathes and shifts its weight in place, its glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: squeezes the fire newt and it spits a stream of embers forward to the right

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
